---
title: "Start here"
subtitle: "Does morphology affect survival only through performance?"
---

This site is the complete, open record of a study of natural selection in
three *Anolis* lizards on Lizard Island. Every step is here, from the
cleaned field data to the final biological conclusions: data cleaning
decisions, model equations, Stan code, validation and model checks. The
pages are meant to be read in order, but each one stands on its own.

## The question

Many evolutionary studies link morphology directly to survival or
reproductive success. The **ecomorphological paradigm** proposes a
middle step instead: morphology determines what an animal can *do*, its
whole-organism performance, and performance determines whether it
survives.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "The paradigm being tested. Solid arrows are the mediated path; the dashed arrow is a direct effect of morphology on survival that bypasses measured performance."
flowchart LR
  M[Morphology] --> P[Performance] --> S[Survival] --> R[Resighting]
  M -.-> S
```

We test two hypotheses:

- **M1, full mediation.** Morphology affects 6-month survival *only*
  through sprint speed, bite force and clinging ability on bark and on
  leaves.
- **M2, partial mediation.** Morphology also affects survival directly,
  through routes that measured performance does not capture.

## Study system

Lizards were captured, measured, tested for performance and individually
marked in spring 2024, then resighted in fall 2024 (6 months) and spring
2025 (12 months). We analyse three species that share the island:

| Species | Abbreviation |
|---|---|
| *Anolis carolinensis* | caro |
| *Anolis cristatellus* | cris |
| *Anolis sagrei* | sag |

Survival is never observed directly, only resightings. Lizards that are
alive can be missed, and how often differs among species. The model
therefore estimates detection probability alongside survival.

## Reproducing the analysis

The repository contains everything needed to reproduce the results from
the cleaned data:

```
data/        cleaned analysis dataset and capture summary
R/           shared functions: data preparation, priors, simulator, plot theme
stan/        Stan model
scripts/     long computations (SBC, model fits), saved to results/
figures/     static figures (causal diagram)
*.qmd        the pages of this site
```

To rebuild the site, clone the repository, install the R packages loaded
in `R/` and the pages, and run `quarto render`. Heavy computations
(simulation-based calibration and model fits) are run separately from
`scripts/`, and their saved outputs are read by the pages.

## Data availability

The analysis uses `data/lizards-spring-2024.csv`, which has one row per
lizard marked in spring 2024. It includes every correction and exclusion
as columns (`corrections`, `exclusion`), so each cleaning decision on
the [Data page](01-data.qmd) can be traced. The raw field data are not
part of the public repository. The cleaned file is produced from them by
`R/process-raw-data.R`, which is included so that every cleaning step is
documented.
